# MECCANO

Egocentric industrial assembly data supporting action and next-active-object anticipation.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** An egocentric assembly prefix, optionally with depth and gaze in the multimodal extension.

**Output / label:** The upcoming action and next active object.

![Author MECCANO multimodal assembly example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fpv-iplab/MECCANO/master/images/MECCANO_Multimodal.gif)

*Author demonstration of multimodal observations; the future-action output above is illustrative.*

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://github.com/fpv-iplab/MECCANO)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://github.com/fpv-iplab/MECCANO), [project](https://iplab.dmi.unict.it/MECCANO/)

## Intention in this dataset

Predict the next assembly action or interacted object. These future behavior labels proxy object-directed intent and do not identify an independently reported goal.

**Relevance:** `implicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2021

**Domains:** industrial_collaboration, human_object_interaction  
**Intention types:** action, object_interaction  
**Tasks:** action_anticipation, human_object_interaction_prediction  
**Modalities:** rgb, depth, gaze  
**Formats:** video, structured_annotation, time_series
